full_name: Christopher L. Hill | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Hilles Bush Fellow University of Michigan
bio: Christopher L. Hill is a scholar of comparative literature and intellectual history who has written on nationalism, the history of concepts, and the novel as a global form. At Radcliffe, he will complete a book on Japanese writers’ responses to the decolonization of Asia and Africa that places postwar Japanese literature in the context of anticolonial culture from the 1950s to the 1970s.
